description_en: Counts the number of join permissions owned by the current user account that match the specified filter conditions
description_zh: 统计符合过滤条件的当前用户账号所拥有的入网凭证的数量
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan count-owned-join-permissions --fuzzy-renter-aliyun-id some-user --fuzzy-join-eui d896e0 --enabled true --fuzzy-join-permission-name test --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CountOwnedJoinPermissions

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission tenant for fuzzy matching
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证租户的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: fuzzy_renter_aliyun_id

parameters.help_en: The JoinEUI used by the join permission for fuzzy matching
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证使用的JoinEUI
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_eui

parameters.help_en:
Filters join permissions by enabled or disabled status.

A value of true indicates enabled. A value of false indicates disabled
parameters.help_zh:
按照凭证的启停用状态进行过滤。

true表示启用，false表示停用
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The name of the join permission for fuzzy matching
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证的名称
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_permission_name

Data.description_en: The total number of join permissions that match the filter conditions
Data.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的入网凭证总数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
